comment: Fixed flowchart layout (FR-64), designed for the 1920x1080 target at zoom 1. Bands top to bottom: front end, third-party libraries, back end, legacy (SRD 9.1; four zones, VS-07). Every flow of SRD 3.1 (4.7) is one arrow per direction (FR-65): the display client and the models reach the data server directly over HTTP (no gateway, 4.7), commands are pushed to the models and the importer, and the importer writes inside the server. Segments are horizontal or vertical and never cross a card (VS-13). The CSV importer and Models are the size of the subsystem cards of the adoption opening (layout-opening.json, FR-120, AT-64), so the merge only moves them (VS-25, D-330). note is the god's-eye note (FR-68a); status and key are the boxes below the flowchart. Checked by web/e2e/shell.spec.ts.
